name: FlexInput Virtual Mouse
notes: Plain-HID virtual relative mouse (FunctionMode 0, no companion). 6-byte report: [buttons(5)+pad(3), X lo, X hi, Y lo, Y hi, wheel] -- X/Y are int16 relative mickeys, wheel int8 clicks. No Report ID. Kernel-level pointer input via mouhid: immune to the user-mode injected-input filters that silently eat SendInput (ASUS Armoury Crate stack / hardened Win11 builds -- the reason this profile exists), and games see it as a real raw-input mouse. Reports are built directly by flexinput-virtual's keymouse_hm and published via HidMaestroDevice::write_raw_input; sub-pixel remainders carry across frames on the writer side. VID 0x1209 (pid.codes space, unregistered PID) -- cosmetic only for a ROOT-enumerated node; deliberately NOT 045E or gamepad-adjacent (see xbox360.json).
